# Repair cafe before the summer pause

The repair cafe will close for August. Put the date on every booking confirmation now, while visitors still have alternatives. A planned pause is part of the service, not an apology added after the rota fails. [[Repair ideas]] should preserve the parts list and referral contacts so September does not require rebuilding everything from memory.
